title: betterlite LiteLLM pin
description: The LiteLLM release betterlite reimplements, which of its paths count as product, and which of those are left out on purpose.

commit.description: The commit the oracle and every LiteLLM link pin.

excluded.description: Paths under the roots that betterlite deliberately does not reimplement.

roots.description: Paths in the LiteLLM repository that make up the product. A directory ends with a slash.

glob.description: Glob over LiteLLM paths. `*` stays inside one directory, `**` crosses directories.
